description.zh: 黑名单版本列表，英文逗号分隔，黑白名单不能同时设置。
description.en: The blacklist version list, separated by commas. Blacklists and whitelists cannot be set at the same time.

description.zh: 白名单版本列表，英文逗号分隔。
description.en: The whitelist version list, separated by commas.

title.zh: 更新系统版本的黑白名单
title.en: Update blacklists and whitelists for an operating system version

descriptions.zh: 例如，若配置某个系统版本，只有哪些低版本的系统版本才能升级到此版本时，可以设置版本白名单。黑白名单不能同时设置。
descriptions.en: For example, if you want to configure a specific operating system version so that only certain earlier versions can be upgraded to it, set a version whitelist. Blacklists and whitelists cannot be set at the same time.
